title: Off-planet pin given at Cape Canaveral

tellings.quote: Well, uh that pen was given to me by uh someone everybody has read about right down at Cape Canaveral without saying names.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs and whom NASA has taken an interest in, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about a pin with an "off-planet" theme. He says that sometime around 2007 to 2010 it was handed to him at Cape Canaveral, the Florida rocket launch site, by someone "everybody has read about," though he would not say who. If true, it would mean someone well known in the space world quietly reached out to him.
